summary: SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing a non-binding LOI to acquire 100% of American Industrial Technologies (AIT), which operates Q1, a telecom/logistics platform. Terms like price, premium, and deal structure are not yet specified; definitive documents are to be negotiated. The LOI includes a 45-day exclusivity period, renewable for 15 days, and only confidentiality, exclusivity, and expense provisions are binding. The SPAC's trust supports the acquisition. Watch for execution of definitive docs and shareholder vote; risk-arb centers on SPAC market conditions and merger approval odds.
